exposure: Diagnosis of isolated oligohydramnios by amniotic fluid index (AFI)
Diagnosis of isolated oligohydramnios by single deepest vertical pocket (SDVP)
cohort: 110 pregnant females, aged 18 to 35 years with parity less than 5, diagnosed with isolated oligohydramnios.
finding: The frequency of diagnosis, induction of labor, and caesarean section in patients with isolated oligohydramnios diagnosed by the amniotic fluid index is higher as compared to the single deepest vertical pocket.
mod_finding: The frequency of induction of labor and caesarean section was higher in patients diagnosed with isolated oligohydramnios using the amniotic fluid index compared to the single deepest vertical pocket.
